name: Microbe bloom
text: The engineered microbes multiply faster than planned. If the crews feed them now, they speed up the work.

name: Volunteer crews
text: Off-duty workers from nearby colonies offer to help, if you pay for their passage.

name: Domain records
text: A salvage crew found old Domain survey records of this world. They ask a good price for them.

name: Breakthrough
text: The engineers find a better way to do the work.

name: Ice storm
text: A comet breaks up too early. Its ice hits the delivery equipment.

name: Solar flare
text: The star flares. The arrays can turn away from it, or hold their place and stress the power grid below.

name: Deep quake
text: A quake shakes the deep shafts. Some of the drilling gear is buried.

name: Settler unrest
text: Settlers protest against the work and the noise. Some of them stop working.

name: Storm season
text: The storm season comes earlier than the forecast said, and the crews must leave the work sites.

name: Crop blight
text: A blight spreads through the test beds and kills the first plantings.

name: Parts delay
text: A shipment of spare parts is late. The crews can buy the parts nearby at a higher price.

name: Containment breach
text: A gas reservoir ruptures. A cloud of process gas spreads over the work sites and a nearby town.

name: Array collision
text: Debris hits an orbital array, and the broken segments hit more of it.

name: Comet strike
text: A shepherded comet leaves its path and strikes near a settlement.

name: Deep collapse
text: The deep shafts collapse, and crews are trapped below.

name: Sabotage
text: Someone sabotages the project's control center. The damage is heavy.
